title: Accenture weighs $1.5 billion sale of China business as AI push reshapes growth strategy: Report
script:
One point five billion dollars. That is the estimated price tag for Accenture and its China business.
Accenture is exploring options for its operations in the region as a push toward automated systems reshapes its growth strategy.
The potential sale reflects how global professional services firms are adapting to rapid shifts in enterprise technology.
Corporate leaders are reassessing their footprint in local markets to focus resources on software development and automated tools.
Would you divest a major regional unit to fund a new enterprise software push?
